experiment_data.hypothesis: Multi-seed (s123, s456) training across 5 Qwen conditions (PCGrad, UG, LoRA-only, TG, SS) to establish mean±std for all claims. 8 training runs + AR eval N≥50 each. Expect TF convergence (GAR~0.50) and consistent AR rankings across seeds.

spec.notes: 8 sequential runs: PCGrad s123/s456, UG s123/s456, LO s123/s456, TG s456, SS s456(eval-only). Each run ~7h, total ~56h. Auto AR eval N=50 after each.
